# E1003: the tip is not clean: it differs from the newest version in history/

The tip is not clean: its schema differs from that of the newest version
under `history/`. A clean tip equals the last version cut, with no lenses of
its own; CI checks it to assert that the tip was cut before merging. The tip
says which version it would be cut as.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a:  string
	b?: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E1003]: the Schema in tip.thema differs from the one in history/0.0.thema
 --> ship/tip.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: the tip cuts as 0.1
  = help: cut the tip to history/0.1.thema, or make its Schema equal history/0.0.thema's
```
